source_vs_expectation.note: The Aurora security page says clusters 'must be created in a virtual private cloud (VPC)' (fact aurora-security-vpc-required-security-group), but the Aurora FAQ page for Serverless says an Aurora serverless instance can be created without a VPC through express configuration (faq lens facts aurora-serverless-faq-express-config-no-vpc). Writers should keep both and label the express configuration as the newer path.

Encryption at rest is now on by default for new clusters created on or after 2026-02-18 (AWS owned key). The behaviour facts here (cannot turn off, cannot convert in place, snapshot must use the same key) are current; the default itself is a change fact (aurora-change-default-encryption-*).

TLS requirement parameters are on the engine security pages: require_secure_transport (MySQL; default OFF in versions 2 and 3, ON in 8.4) and rds.force_ssl (PostgreSQL). The general SSL page does not name them.

The HA page states 'Aurora Replicas use asynchronous replication' for the instance-level replicas while the storage layer replicates synchronously to six storage nodes. Both facts are stored: aurora-replicas-asynchronous-replication-no-primary-impact and aurora-synchronous-replication-to-six-storage-nodes. Writers must not call replica lag zero.
The docs name the feature 'Aurora serverless' (no v2); the facts follow the current name.

The docs say Aurora Auto Scaling is not supported for Aurora serverless (faq/numbers lens fact aurora-serverless-not-supported-with-aurora-auto-scaling); readers can be pre-created and scaled down instead (fact aurora-serverless-readers-alternative-to-aurora-auto-scaling).

quote_method_notes: A sentence that starts right after a bold list label ('**Label** - ...') fails M4 with facts add; facts adopt --sentence handles it (used for 14 facts).
A sentence that holds a Markdown link inside it cannot be quoted (M3); such sentences were skipped.
Facts with two quotes (quote plus q2) state one claim that both quotes together support.
